summary: CalciMedica filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 15, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Staff letter confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had been notified March 16, 2026 that its common stock (CALC) traded below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, with until September 14, 2026 to cure. The Staff found the closing bid price at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, August 31 to September 14, 2026. No outstanding Nasdaq deficiency notices remain. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure and any reverse-split or continued-listing risk.
